limits: Pure offline engineering controls on caller-supplied proposer/prober callbacks. The module launches no host, model, process or paid route and reads no files; scores are whatever an independent verifier callback returns, so no utility, precision or cost claim is made and the callbacks' own independence is not verified here. One fixed round: base probe, general probe, task probe, composed probe (policy maxProbes 1..4 counts every probe; retries and reflection are not implemented). Composition is a deterministic union of disjoint or identical per-path changes; conflicting or oversize composition is recorded and not probed. Candidates are scored against the unchanged base and selected only when they exceed it by the frozen margin; ties with the base keep the base and tied top candidates are inconclusive. Each candidate hash binds the base inventory overlaid with the changes, but the per-candidate manifest, T004 admission/reservation, T007 durable attempt journal and T008 native containment that a real dispatch needs are separate gates not exercised here. Guidance-only surface and protected components are enforced by reusing harness_surface.SurfaceSpec; text content is inert untrusted data and the rationale is bounded then discarded, never recorded or passed to the prober. Upstream recursion/selection mechanisms are adapted (stage structure, anonymized comparison with the base) with provenance in the module header and every decision record; upstream parallelism, reflection and adoption-by-output-presence are not carried over.
outcome: Ties, regressions, invalid proposals (14 reason codes), missing/malformed/failed/refused probe outputs, explicit abstention, proposer failure, budget exhaustion, composition conflict and unusable base each yield candidate, keep-base, inconclusive or refused with fixed reason codes; no prober output, rationale or proposal field can carry or alter the policy, which is re-verified against the manifest hash before use; generated output alone never wins.
